15−5 = 10
41−15 = 26

Second differences:
10−2 = 8
26−10 = 16
⟶ Next: 24 (difference of 8)

Next first difference:
26 + 24 = 50

Next number:

questions.question: Statement: Essay writing is an art. It requires an understanding of the subject as well as a command over the language to be able to write a good essay. Assumptions: I. Essays cannot be written without complete mastery over the subject. II. Anyone with a good command over the language can write a good essay.
questions.questionHtml:
Statement:

Essay writing is an art. It requires an understanding of the subject as well as a command over the language to be able to write a good essay.

Assumptions:

I. Essays cannot be written without complete mastery over the subject.

II. Anyone with a good command over the language can write a good essay.

options.text: Neither assumption I nor II is implicit
options.html: Neither assumption I nor II is implicit

options.text: Both assumptions I and II are implicit
options.html: Both assumptions I and II are implicit

questions.solution:
Assumption I talks about complete mastery — but the statement only mentions understanding, not mastery. So I is not implicit.

Assumption II says anyone with good command over language can write a good essay — but the statement says both subject understanding and language are needed. So II is also not implicit.

Hence, neither assumption is implicit

questions.question: Statement: In 2021, the government of country M regulated the fishing industry by announcing that each fisherman can take their boat for fishing only once a day. Which of the following can be concluded from the given information? I. The sale of fishing boats in country M will double in the coming years. II. Fishermen with bigger boats will benefit more from this regulation as compared to those who have smaller boats.
questions.questionHtml:
Statement:
In 2021, the government of country M regulated the fishing industry by announcing that each fisherman can take their boat for fishing only once a day.

Which of the following can be concluded from the given information?
I. The sale of fishing boats in country M will double in the coming years.
II. Fishermen with bigger boats will benefit more from this regulation as compared to those who have smaller boats.

options.text: Both I and II can be concluded from the given information.
options.html: Both I and II can be concluded from the given information.

options.text: Only I can be concluded from the given information.
options.html: Only I can be concluded from the given information.

options.text: Only II can be concluded from the given information.
options.html: Only II can be concluded from the given information.

options.text: Neither I nor II can be concluded from the given information.
options.html: Neither I nor II can be concluded from the given information.

questions.solution:
Statement:

In 2021, the government of country M regulated the fishing industry by announcing that each fisherman can take their boat for fishing only once a day.

Conclusion I:

The sale of fishing boats in country M will double in the coming years.

→ This is speculative. The statement does not mention any trend or prediction about boat sales. ❌

Conclusion II:

Fishermen with bigger boats will benefit more from this regulation as compared to those who have smaller boats.

→ This is a reasonable inference. Since fishing is limited to once a day, those with bigger boats can potentially catch more in a single trip, giving them an advantage. ✅

Answer: (3) Only II can be concluded from the given information.

questions.question: Given below is a 'main statement' followed by four subsidiary statements. From the given options, choose the ordered pair of subsidiary statements, where the first statement implies the second and the two statements are logically consistent with the main statement. Main Statement: You can drive over 60 km/h only on the national highways. Subsidiary Statements: A. You are on the national highways. B. You cannot drive over 60 km/h. C. You can drive over 60 km/h. D. You are not on the national highway.
questions.questionHtml:
Given below is a 'main statement' followed by four subsidiary statements.
From the given options, choose the ordered pair of subsidiary statements, where the first statement implies the second and the two statements are logically consistent with the main statement.

Main Statement:

You can drive over 60 km/h only on the national highways.

Subsidiary Statements:

A. You are on the national highways.
B. You cannot drive over 60 km/h.
C. You can drive over 60 km/h.
D. You are not on the national highway.
questions.solution:
Out of the given pairs, option (a) is the required answer.
In which the given statement B ("You cannot drive over 60 km/h") is implicit in statement D ("You are not on the national highway") — because according to the main statement, only on national highways can you drive over 60 km/h.

So if you are not on a national highway (D), then you cannot drive over 60 km/h (B).

Hence, both D ⇒ B and both are logically consistent with the main statement.
